sloka: मातुलस्ते महाबाहो वाक्यमाह नरर्षभः ।युधाजित्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं श्रूयतां यदि रोचते ।। ७.१००.९ ॥
transliteration: mātulaste mahābāho vākyamāha nararṣabhaḥ ।yudhājitprītisaṁyuktaṁ śrūyatāṁ yadi rocate ।। 7.100.9 ॥

translations.english: Yudhājit, your maternal uncle, O mighty-armed Rama, has spoken words filled with affection, which you should hear if they please you.
